question: Can the official NCL06270 catalogue's digital-authorization button be treated as a free anonymous original image route for 徐安1600 juan45?

specific_holding.catalogued_edition: 明萬曆庚子(二十八年,1600)延安知府徐安刊本
specific_holding.public_html_observation: The retrieved first-party detail offers 到館調閱古籍 and 申請數位授權. It does NOT show an 進入影像瀏覽 action in the public HTML rendering. This is only a visible-page boundary, not an assertion that the library has no scan or that an authenticated viewer cannot exist.

faq.relevant_rule: Official FAQ says image authorization is available when the exact bibliographic item already has digitized images; if there is no digital image the service does not provide digital authorization. Scanned items are primarily for online browsing; other originals may require onsite request and research justification.

license.noncommercial_person: Other corporate applicants or natural persons may be charged half of the public tariff for approved noncommercial use; specified public agencies, registered schools and public-interest organizations may obtain permission free if approved. This is NOT an automatic individual free-delivery entitlement.
license.published_base_price: 72dpi JPEG NT$50 per image; 300dpi JPEG/TIFF print-grade NT$500 up to 5MB, higher tiers by size
license.application: Formal application requires real applicant/contact, phone/address and acceptance of usage conditions; ordinary approval requires separate review and payment where applicable.
license.pricing_scope: Digitized resource licensing/usage rights; NOT proof that all private research browsing, any library reference answer, or any separately offered copying service necessarily incurs this fee.

limits: An application button is not an original digitized folio; do not count catalogue or fees as source-original evidence.
The visible lack of a browser action is bounded to one fetched page view and does NOT prove all 06270 image access impossible.
Fee waivers for specified institutional applicants do not establish a zero-cost path for this user; do not claim institutional status or submit forms.
No source-original 徐安卷45 second-table L132 二/三, 疾 coefficient construction, 少/微 carry or G893 field-unit relationship is resolved.
next_action: Avoid 06270 license/application forms, identity submission and fee commitments on the current free-only authorization. Re-evaluate only if a first-party anonymous source-emitted original target image appears, or a specific verified-free no-login digital-copy route with rights is offered. Meanwhile use already authenticated free original Xu-An 1599 and other independent publicly accessible juan45 scans for true pixel- and plate-scoped collation.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A catalogue item with an application button is not a verified digital copy or a distinct original printing plate.
remaining_questions: NCL06270 actual digitization/image entitlement and first-party target folio identity remain unknown.
